results.title: Top 50 Cal Sports Moments – No. 17: Stadium Debut, 1923
results.snippet: Amazingly, the stadium was ready for use in just 11 months, allowing it to make its debut in the 29th Big Game on November 24, 1923, between an 8-0-1 Cal squad and a 7-1 Stanford team. A crowd of more than 73,000, most of them dressed in their Sunday finest, jammed into a stadium that had an official capacity of 72,609. Approximately 7,000 additional fans viewed the game from the hill adjacent to the stadium, christening Tightwad Hill on Memorial Stadium’s very first day.
